t: The Variable Payments APIs enable AWS Marketplace Sellers to perform manage their payment requests (send, get, list, cancel).

This release supports 1/multi-product transactions via offer sets. DescribeAgreement and SearchAgreements APIs now return offer set IDs. SearchAgreements also supports filtering by offer set ID and 2/variable payment pricing terms will be returned through GetAgreementTerms.
The AWS Marketplace Agreement Service provides an API interface that helps AWS Marketplace sellers manage their agreements, including listing, filtering, and viewing details about their agreements.
